finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: It has the strongest for evidence, including bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses and a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells.

finalists.label: Myositis
finalists.why: It has a strong for evidence, including elevated creatine kinase and a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells, with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Castleman disease
finalists.why: It has a strong for evidence, including bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses, intermittent fevers, and episodic night sweats, with no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses and a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells, which are more specific to Lymphoma, decided the final comparison.
